SIND CO‑OPERATIVE SOCIETIES (REFORMS) RULES, 1973
[Gazette of Sind, Part IV‑A,
14th June 1973]
No. S. O. (C)‑16(38)/72 in exercise of the
powers conferred by Article 13 of the Co‑operative Societies (Reforms)
Order, 1972 (President's Order No. 9 of 1972), the Government of Sind are
pleased to make the following rules, namely:‑
1. Short title
and commencement.‑(1) These rules may be called Sind Co‑operative
Societies (Reform) Rules, 1973.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.‑(1)
In these rules, unless the context otherwise requires, the following
expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them that
Is to say‑
(a) "Article" means Article of the Order;
(b) "Order" means the
Co‑operative Societies (Reforms) Order, 1972 (P. O. No. 9 of 1972).
(2) Words
and expressions used In ' these rules but not defined shall have the same
meanings as are assigned to them under the Order.
3. Duties of
the Co‑operative Banks.‑‑(1) The Co‑operative Banks
shall‑ publish the names of individual members who have ceased to be such
members by virtue of the provisions of the Order;
(ii) within such time as may be specified by the
Registrar, amend their bye‑laws (by whatever name such bye‑laws may
by called) so as to bring them in accord with the provisions of the Order;
(iii) submit a copy of the amendments made in the bye‑laws
in pursuance of the provisions of clause (II) alongwith the bye‑laws ;
(iv) keep intact a sum sufficient to make refund of
share money to the individual members ;
(v) comply with all lawful directions issued from
time to time by the Registrar.
4. Registration
of amendments of the bye‑laws.‑(1) All amendments of the bye‑laws
submitted under rule 3 shall if such amendments are not contrary to the Order
and directions of the Registrar, be registered by the Registrar and a certified
copy of such amendments shall be returned to the Bank.
(2) If, any Co‑operative Bank falls to carry
out amendments of Its bye‑laws !n pursuance of the provisions of rule 3
within the specified time, the Registrar may amend the bye‑laws in
accordance with the provisions of the Order and such amendments shall be
registered and certified copy thereof furnished to the Bank.
(3) The amendments made in the bye‑laws shall
be deemed to have taken effect on and from the date a copy of the registered
amendment is supplied to the Bank.
5. Dealing with
Non‑Members.‑The Manager of the Cooperative Banks shall furnish
quarterly return to The Deputy Registrar, Assistant Registrar, and Special Auditor,
Co‑operative Societies in the forms prescribed by the Registrar,
containing particularly the following information.‑
(a) Names
and correct addresses of the persons admitted to membership of the Bank during
the quarter.
(b) The new accounts opened during
the quarter.
(c) In case of other banks a declaration shall also
be furnished to the effect that no dealing has been made with the non‑members
except as
provided under clause (2) of Article 7.
6. Powers of
Inspection.‑The Registrar or any person authorised by him, shall for
the purpose of ensuring that the provisions of the Order and these Rules are
complied with, have powers to inspect the Co‑operativg Banks and their
records
7. Powers of the
Registrar.‑The Registrar shall have powers to make orders for all or
any of the following matters namely;
(a) ensuring the due performance of their duties by
persons employed by, or connected with a Co‑operative Bang; and
(b) prohibiting any thing likely to Interfere with
the proper functioning of the Bang.
8. Offences,
Penalties and Cognizance of offences.‑(1) Whoever contra?venes the
provisions of the Order or these Rule shall be punished with imprisonment for a
term which may extend to one year or with fine or with both.
(2) No Court shall take cognizance of any offences
punishable under this rule, except on the complaint made !n writing by the
Registrar or any person authorised by him in this behalf.
